EditMarker.description: A timeline position to restore when the edit ends (null: the end), or false to leave the timeline in place.

IdOrName.description: A feature's id (a number) or its name.

restore_marker.description:
A position (or null, the end of the timeline): temporarily roll to this sketch and
restore that position when the edit ends. Left out, a sketch with features after it is
rolled to and the current position restored, so those features rebuild once, when the
edit ends (#14010). `false` leaves the timeline in place, rebuilding them after every
sketch command.

label: Edit Sketch
params: sketch: id or name; restore_marker?: nonnegative timeline position, null (end) or false. A position or null: temporarily roll to this sketch and restore that position on Finish or Cancel; Finish groups the edit into one Undo step. Omitted: the same with the current position when features come after the sketch, so they rebuild once at Finish rather than after every sketch command. false: leave the timeline in place (later features rebuild after every sketch command)
